dateline: BTS's ARIRANG World Tour continues in La Plata, Argentina (Oct 21, 23, 24) after a Santiago opening run.
heroHeadline: Day 4,880: BTS in Argentina After Santiago Opener
heroSubtitle: October 23, 2026 is Day 4,880 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS opened the ARIRANG World Tour's Chile run on Oct 14 at Estadio Nacional (reported ~69,000 attendees) after a venue dispute over the 360-degree stage; three La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) follow.
